notes.title: Price change!
notes.notes:
Dear community,
[url=http://www.displacementstudios.com]Displacement Studios[/url] acquired [i]Neon Coliseum[/i], and as one of the first changes, the price has been decreased to $0.99 to make it more affordable for everyone who hasn't purchased it yet. The game is now available at a discounted price in the publisher bundle, too.
